# libsamplerate 0.2.2

Source: https://github.com/libsndfile/libsamplerate/releases/tag/0.2.2
Archive: https://codeload.github.com/libsndfile/libsamplerate/tar.gz/refs/tags/0.2.2
SHA-256: `16e881487f184250deb4fcb60432d7556ab12cb58caea71ef23960aec6c0405a`

Selected upstream source files are unmodified. Local config.h targets little-endian macOS and enables Fastest/Medium Sinc (Best omitted). Linear/ZOH compiled for upstream linkage, not selected by application. BSD-2-Clause license in COPYING; included in app resources. No dynamic/system dependency and no network needed to build.
